name: Aletheia MCP
description: Local memory and rules hub for AI coding tools: one SQLite store on the user's machine, shared by every connected tool. Reads, memory saves and reversible dismissals keep Guard's usual handling; adding or confirming a standing rule and replacing a work-state list are gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Every tool reads or writes only the local SQLite store; none sends data off the machine. Set ALETHEIA_DATA_DIR or ALETHEIA_HUB_DB to keep a separate store.
add_rule stores a standing rule that later reaches every connected tool's session start context, so it stays on review; list_rules only reads.
Memory text is redacted for secrets before it is stored, and recalled memory is returned to the model marked as untrusted data.
dismiss_memory hides an item without deleting it; restore_memory undoes it. work_state_write replaces a whole list, so it stays on review.
This entry matches npx aletheia-mem mcp (0.1.13 or newer). The installer's bun <path>/bin/mcp.mjs launch is not a package launch and keeps Guard's normal handling.
